instruction: The audio always plays ahead of the video on my system — set VLC to permanently delay audio by 200 milliseconds.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'audio-desync', default: '0' } ] }); return data[0]; }
